SELECT 
    lt.leave_type_id, 
    sc.status_id 
FROM employees e
CROSS JOIN leave_types lt
CROSS JOIN status_codes sc
WHERE e.employee_id = '{{ $json.employee_id }}'
AND UPPER(lt.leave_type_name) ILIKE '%' || UPPER('{{ $json.leave_type }}') || '%'
AND sc.status_code = 'PENDING'
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE employee_leaves el SET status_id = sc.status_id FROM status_codes sc, employees e WHERE sc.status_code = 'CANCELLED' AND e.email = '{{ $json.user_email }}' AND el.employee_id = e.employee_id AND el.leave_id = {{ $json.leave_id }} RETURNING el.leave_id

SELECT el.leave_id, lt.leave_type_name, el.start_date, el.end_date, el.total_days, el.reason, el.applied_at, sc.status_code, sc.status_description FROM employee_leaves el JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = el.employee_id JOIN leave_types lt ON lt.leave_type_id = el.leave_type_id JOIN status_codes sc ON sc.status_id = el.status_id WHERE e.email = '{{ $json.user_email }}' ORDER BY el.applied_at DESC LIMIT 50

parameters.query: SELECT lt.leave_type_name, COALESCE(SUM(el.total_days) FILTER (WHERE sc.status_code = 'APPROVED'), 0) AS used, CASE lt.leave_type_name WHEN 'Annual Leave' THEN 14 WHEN 'Sick Leave' THEN 14 WHEN 'Emergency Leave' THEN 3 WHEN 'Personal Leave' THEN 2 WHEN 'Maternity Leave' THEN 60 WHEN 'Paternity Leave' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS entitled, e.employment_start_date FROM employees e CROSS JOIN leave_types lt LEFT JOIN employee_leaves el ON el.employee_id = e.employee_id AND el.leave_type_id = lt.leave_type_id AND el.start_date >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW()) LEFT JOIN status_codes sc ON sc.status_id = el.status_id WHERE e.email = '={{ $json.user_email }}' GROUP BY lt.leave_type_name, e.employment_start_date

INSERT INTO public.work_shifts (shift_name, start_time, end_time, created_by) VALUES ('{{ $json.shift_name }}', '{{ $json.start_time }}'::time, '{{ $json.end_time }}'::time, (SELECT employee_id FROM employees WHERE email = '{{ $json.user_email }}' LIMIT 1)) RETURNING shift_id, shift_name, start_time::text, end_time::text

SELECT et.timetable_id, et.work_date::text, et.is_off, ws.shift_id, ws.shift_name, ws.start_time::text AS start_time, ws.end_time::text AS end_time, ea.attendance_id, ea.clock_in_time, ea.clock_out_time, CASE WHEN et.is_off THEN 'rest_day' WHEN ea.attendance_id IS NULL AND et.work_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'absent' WHEN ea.attendance_id IS NULL THEN 'scheduled' WHEN ea.clock_in_time::time <= (ws.start_time + INTERVAL '5 minutes') THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'late' END AS punch_status, CASE WHEN ea.clock_out_time IS NOT NULL AND ea.clock_out_time::time > ws.end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_ot, CASE WHEN ea.clock_out_time IS NOT NULL AND ea.clock_out_time::time > ws.end_time THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ea.clock_out_time::time - ws.end_time)) / 3600.0, 2) ELSE 0 END AS ot_hours FROM public.employee_timetable et JOIN public.work_shifts ws ON ws.shift_id = et.shift_id LEFT JOIN public.employee_attendance ea ON ea.employee_id = et.employee_id AND ea.clock_in_time::date = et.work_date WHERE et.employee_id = (SELECT employee_id FROM employees WHERE email = '{{ $json.user_email }}' LIMIT 1) AND et.work_date >= '{{ $json.month_start }}'::date AND et.work_date <= '{{ $json.month_end }}'::date ORDER BY et.work_date ASC

SELECT et.timetable_id, et.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.email, et.work_date::text, et.is_off, ws.shift_id, ws.shift_name, ws.start_time::text, ws.end_time::text, CASE WHEN et.is_off THEN 'rest_day' WHEN ea.attendance_id IS NULL AND et.work_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'absent' WHEN ea.attendance_id IS NULL THEN 'scheduled' WHEN ea.clock_in_time::time <= (ws.start_time + INTERVAL '5 minutes') THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'late' END AS punch_status FROM public.employee_timetable et JOIN public.employees e ON e.employee_id = et.employee_id JOIN public.work_shifts ws ON ws.shift_id = et.shift_id LEFT JOIN public.employee_attendance ea ON ea.employee_id = et.employee_id AND ea.clock_in_time::date = et.work_date WHERE et.work_date >= '{{ $json.month_start }}'::date AND et.work_date <= '{{ $json.month_end }}'::date ORDER BY et.work_date ASC, e.employee_name ASC

INSERT INTO public.employee_timetable (employee_id, shift_id, work_date, is_off, created_by) SELECT {{ $json.target_employee_id }}, {{ $json.shift_id }}, gs::date, {{ $json.is_off || false }}, (SELECT employee_id FROM employees WHERE email = '{{ $json.user_email }}' LIMIT 1) FROM generate_series('{{ $json.start_date }}'::date, '{{ $json.end_date }}'::date, '1 day'::interval) gs WHERE ({{ $json.weekdays_only || false }} = false OR EXTRACT(DOW FROM gs) NOT IN (0, 6)) ON CONFLICT (employee_id, work_date) DO UPDATE SET shift_id = EXCLUDED.shift_id, is_off = EXCLUDED.is_off, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by RETURNING timetable_id, work_date::text, shift_id, is_off

INSERT INTO public.employee_overtime (employee_id, status_id, work_date, hours, reason) SELECT ea.employee_id, (SELECT status_id FROM leave_status WHERE LOWER(status_code) = 'pending' LIMIT 1), CURRENT_DATE, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ea.clock_out_time::time - ws.end_time)) / 3600.0, 2), 'Auto-detected OT (timetable check-out)' FROM public.employee_attendance ea JOIN public.employee_timetable et ON et.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND et.work_date = CURRENT_DATE JOIN public.work_shifts ws ON ws.shift_id = et.shift_id WHERE ea.employee_id = (SELECT employee_id FROM employees WHERE email = '{{ $json.user_email }}' LIMIT 1) AND ea.clock_in_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND ea.clock_out_time IS NOT NULL AND ea.clock_out_time::time > ws.end_time ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING overtime_id, hours

parameters.query: SELECT e.employee_name, e.email AS employee_email, ea.attendance_id, ea.clock_in_time, ea.clock_in_latitude, ea.clock_in_longitude, ea.clock_out_time, ea.clock_out_latitude, ea.clock_out_longitude, CASE WHEN ws.shift_id IS NOT NULL AND ea.clock_in_time IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ea.clock_in_time::time <= (ws.start_time + INTERVAL '5 minutes') THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'late' END ELSE NULL END AS punch_status FROM public.employee_attendance ea JOIN public.employees e ON e.employee_id = ea.employee_id LEFT JOIN public.employee_timetable et ON et.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND et.work_date = ea.clock_in_time::date LEFT JOIN public.work_shifts ws ON ws.shift_id = et.shift_id WHERE ea.clock_in_time::date BETWEEN '{{ $json.start_date }}'::date AND '{{ $json.end_date }}'::date AND ('{{ $json.target_email }}' = '' OR e.email = '{{ $json.target_email }}') ORDER BY ea.clock_in_time DESC
